simple-button.description: This is a simple and light weight button with only onClick functionality

debounce.description: Debounce hook that can be used to delay a callback for example search input after 500ms

truncate.description: truncate(text, maxLength, suffix = "..."): string. Keeps the first maxLength characters and appends suffix if text was longer; the suffix is added on top, so the result can be maxLength + suffix.length long. Returns text unchanged if it fits. Throws RangeError if maxLength is negative or not an integer. Counts UTF-16 units (emoji can be split). Use for character limits outside a CSS box (titles, notifications, previews); for on-screen text prefer Tailwind's `truncate` class

once.description: once(fn): wraps fn so it runs only on the first call; every later call returns the cached first result and ignores its arguments. Generic and type-preserving (same parameters and return type as fn). If fn throws, nothing is cached and the next call runs fn again. Use for one-time initialization, or to guard handlers against double execution

pickRandom.description: pickRandom<T>(array: readonly T[]): T. Returns a uniformly random item using Math.random (not cryptographically secure). Throws RangeError on an empty array. Use for random tips, placeholders or test data; not for security tokens or shuffling
